# Opus Library — AI Agent & Reader Integration Specification
Base URL: https://read.opuslibrary.com
OpenAPI 3.0: https://read.opuslibrary.com/openapi.json
Human Spec Page: https://read.opuslibrary.com/developers

## 1. Open Ebook Reader Protocols (No Auth Required)
- OPDS 1.2 (Atom/XML, static): GET https://read.opuslibrary.com/opds.xml
- OPDS 1.2 (Atom/XML, dynamic D1 + catalog, supports ?q=): GET https://read.opuslibrary.com/api/opds.xml
- OPDS 2.0 (JSON, static): GET https://read.opuslibrary.com/opds.json
- OPDS 2.0 (JSON, dynamic D1 + catalog, supports ?q=): GET https://read.opuslibrary.com/api/opds.json
- OpenSearch Description: GET https://read.opuslibrary.com/opensearch.xml
- W3C / Readium Web Publication Manifest: GET https://read.opuslibrary.com/api/w3c/{slug}/manifest.json
- Static Catalog JSON: GET https://read.opuslibrary.com/catalog.json

## 2. REST API Endpoints (Cloudflare Pages Functions + D1 + R2, CORS Enabled)
- GET    /api/books            -> { "books": [ { slug, title, author, subtitle, chapters, words, cover, epubUrl, status } ] }
- GET    /api/books/{slug}     -> Full book object { title, author, slug, canEdit, chapters: [ { chapter, title, audio, html, segments[], words[] } ] }
- POST   /api/books            -> Auth required. Body: { title, author, text, isPublic } -> 201 { slug, id, chapters, words }
- PUT    /api/books/{slug}     -> Owner auth required. Body: full bookJson -> 200 { ok: true }
- DELETE /api/books/{slug}     -> Owner auth required. Deletes book & render jobs -> 200 { ok: true, deleted }
- POST   /api/books/{slug}/cover  -> Owner auth required. Binary image/jpeg|png body -> 200 { ok: true, coverUrl }
- POST   /api/books/{slug}/render -> Owner auth required. Queues job in D1 `render_jobs` -> 202 { jobId, status: "queued" }
- GET    /api/media/{key}      -> Serves R2 stored covers, audio, and EPUB3 files

## 3. Book & Segment JSON Schema
Each chapter in `chapters[]`:
{
  "chapter": "ch01",
  "title": "Chapter 1: ...",
  "audio": "audio/ch01.m4a",           // relative to /books/{slug}/ unless absolute URL
  "html": "<h1>...</h1><p>...</p>",    // wraps segments in <span class='seg-span' id='seg_{i}'> and words in <span id='w00001'>
  "segments": [
    {
      "role": "narrator|scrooge|alice|...",
      "voice": "en-US-AriaNeural",
      "emotion": "neutral|cheerful|sad|angry|spooky|whisper|hurried|solemn",
      "rate": "+0%",
      "pitch": "+0Hz",
      "volume": "+0%",
      "ambiance": "none|cozy_fireplace|winter_wind|spooky_manor|clock_ticking|festive_bells",
      "sfx": "none|chains_rattle|knocker|bell_chime|door_creak|footsteps|thunder",
      "confidence": "high|low|manual",
      "beginSec": 0.0,
      "endSec": 3.45,
      "text": "..."
    }
  ],
  "words": [
    { "id": "w00001", "segIdx": 0, "text": "Chapter", "beginSec": 0.02 }
  ]
}

## 4. EPUB3 Standard
All downloadable `.epub` files conform to W3C EPUB 3.3 Fixed-Layout (768x1024, pre-paginated) with SMIL 3.0 Media Overlays (`audio/mp4`, `-epub-media-overlay-active`, two-level sentence + word highlighting via `highlight.js`) and pass W3C EPUBCheck 5.1.0 with 0 errors and 0 warnings.

## 5. Automated Test Protocol (Run Before Shipping Any Client)
1. **OPDS 1.2 & 2.0 + OpenSearch**:
   - `GET /opds.xml` -> 200, valid Atom XML, `>= 2` `<entry>` items, includes `<link rel="search" ... href=".../opensearch.xml"/>`.
   - `GET /api/opds.json?q=alice` -> 200, `metadata.numberOfItems == 1`.
   - `GET /opensearch.xml` -> 200, valid OpenSearchDescription.
2. **W3C Manifest + Book JSON + Audio**:
   - `GET /api/w3c/{slug}/manifest.json` -> 200, `conformsTo` includes `https://www.w3.org/TR/epub-33/`, non-empty `readingOrder`.
   - `GET /api/books/{slug}` -> 200, non-empty `chapters[].words[]` and `segments[]`.
   - `HEAD /books/{slug}/audio/ch01.m4a` -> 200.
3. **CORS & Input Validation**:
   - `OPTIONS /api/books` -> 204 with `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`.
   - `POST /api/auth/login` with invalid JSON `{bad` -> 400 (never 500).
4. **Auth + Private Book CRUD + Render Queue + Cleanup**:
   - `POST /api/auth/register` -> 201 + `Set-Cookie: opus_session=...`.
   - `POST /api/books` with `isPublic: false` -> 201 + `{ slug }`.
   - `GET /api/books/{slug}` (authenticated owner) -> 200 (`canEdit: true`).
   - `PUT /api/books/{slug}` -> 200.
   - `POST /api/books/{slug}/render` -> 202 (`status: "queued"`).
   - `DELETE /api/books/{slug}` -> 200, followed by `GET /api/books/{slug}` -> 404.
   - `POST /api/auth/logout` -> 200.
